illustration_style: Richly textured contemporary gouache illustration with layered painted shapes and refined editorial charm.
line_weight: Fine crisp ink-like accents with varied, restrained weight.
line_quality: Slightly organic hand-drawn contours with neat, confident finishing details.
detail_level: Moderate-to-high detail concentrated around the focal storytelling elements; supporting areas use simplified layered forms.
character_language: Friendly, stylised human figures with softly rounded proportions, expressive faces and lively, readable gestures.
background_density: Atmospheric medium-density surroundings built from simplified repeating forms, with carefully preserved breathing room for the greeting.
composition: Clear focal hierarchy with an energetic directional flow, a generously uncluttered area for typography, and balanced decorative framing details.
palette: Festive jewel tones balanced by warm cream, with deep blue-green shadows, cranberry accents and luminous golden highlights.
shading: Soft opaque gouache shading, gentle cast shadows and small warm highlights; no harsh digital gradients.
texture: Visible warm paper grain, lightly dry-brushed paint edges and subtle printed-card tactility.
mood: Joyful, brisk, cosy and warmly nostalgic.
print_considerations: Use strong colour separation and readable dark-to-light contrast for reliable home printing. Keep fine ink details restrained, avoid heavy full-bleed dark coverage where possible, and retain a safe clear zone for trimming and folding.
shared_prompt: Contemporary hand-painted gouache illustration with visible warm paper grain, layered opaque shapes, softly dry-brushed edges and crisp fine ink-like accents. Use a festive jewel-and-cream palette with cobalt and spruce shadows, cranberry notes and luminous gold highlights; gentle painted shading, warm practical glows, expressive rounded character design, refined hand-lettered accents and an upbeat, cosy printed-card finish.
avoid: Any resemblance to existing branded Father Christmas depictions, logos or recognisable card designs
Overly childish cartoon proportions or exaggerated facial features
Cluttered backgrounds that compete with the greeting
Harsh neon colours, muddy shadows or heavy digital gradients
Fine details too small or low-contrast for home printing
